label: Confirm WhatsApp delivery or alert
info: Sends a WhatsApp message, checks 30 seconds later whether it failed, and warns you if it did.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scopes messages:read and messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** Replace +12025550123 with the number that should receive the message. Replace the second number (in the function node) with yours: it receives the warning. A message that is still pending or sent after 30 seconds is not a failure (the person may be offline), so only failed raises the warning.
